Delve into the richness of Romanian culture with *Capra cu trei iezi*. Perfect for building a strong literary foundation, this collection ensures students can engage with classic narratives while following recommended school curricula.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**What is the primary focus of this collection?**
The collection focuses on providing 100 representative titles, drawing equally from traditional Romanian folklore and the works of acclaimed Romanian writers.

**Is this appropriate for different age groups?**
